name: Bromazolam
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Human liver preparations show CYP3A4 hydroxylation and UGT1A4/UGT2B10 N-glucuronidation. Hydroxylated/conjugated metabolites were also identified in human samples; this does not establish complete clinical pharmacokinetics.
